race.comment: POLYMNIA (7) frustrating mare ready to win after the two eye catching performances. Returned excellent closing splits when taking good ground from UNLEESHING over 1600m at this track in BM94 company. Zac Lloyd sticks and well weighted to run over the top of these. THE MONA LISA (5) iron mare who was a month between runs with a respectable fifth with the 57kg over 1600m at this track. Fitter now from a good gate and meets some of these better at the weights. Genuine contender. UNLEESHING (8) starting to put it all together this prep and looks up to this tougher contest. Doesn't get the same map favours today and look for her late. VIVY AIR (4) comes up with a good draw after failing to get into the contest with a battling thirteenth in the G1 Epsom Handicap over this track and trip. Stays in the calculations back to her own sex. KNOBELAS (6) has needed the three runs to bring her to her top and peaked on the run when seventh to UNLEESHING here last start. Keep safe.
